scenarios.criterion: Given a pass, when it starts, the supervisor MUST run `git fetch <remote> <branch>` exactly once and read intake/ at `<remote>/<branch>`. `--remote` defaults to `origin`.
scenarios.name: A pass fetches the configured remote once before reading orders
given: no --remote flag is given, so the remote defaults to origin
the branch under management is main
then: the supervisor fetches origin main exactly once during the pass
intake is read from the remote-tracking ref origin/main, not the bare local branch

scenarios.criterion: Given an order promoted to `ready` on the remote only, the next pass MUST claim it with no pull by a person, and the claim's `sourceCommit` MUST equal the fetched commit.
scenarios.name: An order promoted on the remote only is claimed without a local pull
given: an order is promoted to ready and pushed to the remote
no person has pulled that promotion into the local checkout
then: the order is claimed
the claim's sourceCommit equals the commit the pass fetched

scenarios.criterion: Given a claim, its worktree's branch MUST start from `<remote>/<branch>` at that commit when the order sets no `base-branch` of its own.
scenarios.name: A claimed order with no base-branch starts its worktree from the fetched remote branch
given: an order sets no base-branch of its own
then: the order's worktree branch starts from <remote>/<branch> at the commit the pass fetched

scenarios.criterion: Given the person's checkout, a pass MUST NOT change its branch, index, or working tree, including uncommitted changes and local unpushed commits.
scenarios.name: A pass never disturbs the person's own checkout
given: the person's checkout has uncommitted changes
the person's checkout has local commits not yet pushed
when: a supervisor pass runs, including fetching the remote
then: the checkout's current branch, index, and working tree remain exactly as they were before the pass
the uncommitted changes and unpushed commits are untouched

scenarios.criterion: Given a fetch that fails (no network, no remote by that name, bad credentials), the pass MUST go on from the last fetched `<remote>/<branch>` and print exactly one line saying the fetch failed and why. It MUST NOT park or fail any order.
scenarios.name: A failed fetch does not stop the pass or any order
given: the configured remote cannot be reached, such as no network, no remote by that name, or bad credentials
then: the pass continues using the last successfully fetched <remote>/<branch>
exactly one line is printed stating the fetch failed and why
no order is parked or failed because the fetch failed

scenarios.criterion: Given a repository with no remote by the configured name, or `--no-fetch`, the supervisor MUST read the local `<branch>` exactly as today, with no fetch attempted and no new output. Every existing test MUST keep passing with no change to what it asserts.
scenarios.name: No remote by the configured name reads the local branch unchanged
given: the repository has no remote by the configured name
then: no fetch is attempted
intake is read from the local branch exactly as before this change
no new output is produced

scenarios.criterion: Given a repository with no remote by the configured name, or `--no-fetch`, the supervisor MUST read the local `<branch>` exactly as today, with no fetch attempted and no new output. Every existing test MUST keep passing with no change to what it asserts.
scenarios.name: Passing --no-fetch reads the local branch unchanged even when a remote exists
given: a remote by the configured name exists and is reachable
then: no fetch is attempted
intake is read from the local branch exactly as before this change
no new output is produced

scenarios.criterion: Given a running or waiting order, a fetch that moves `<remote>/<branch>` MUST NOT change it. The order MUST keep its claimed `sourceCommit`; only `loom factory rerun` takes a newer version.
scenarios.name: A later fetch does not move a running or waiting order's claimed commit
given: an order is already running or waiting, claimed at a particular sourceCommit
when: a later supervisor pass fetches a remote branch that has moved forward
then: the order's claimed sourceCommit remains unchanged
only an explicit loom factory rerun picks up the newer commit

scenarios.criterion: Given `templates/claude-feature-team/intake/README.md`, it MUST say orders are read from the remote after a fetch, that a promotion must be pushed, and how `--no-fetch` restores the old behavior.
scenarios.name: The intake README explains the fetch-before-read behavior
given: a person is reading templates/claude-feature-team/intake/README.md to understand how orders are picked up
when: they read the section describing how loom factory enforces pickup
then: the README states orders are read from the remote after a fetch
the README states a promotion must be pushed, not just committed locally, to be seen
the README states how --no-fetch restores the previous local-branch-only behavior

scenarios.criterion: Given the change is complete, every new or changed function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test that can fail, `go test ./...` and the lint MUST pass, and no file outside `scope.paths` MUST change, excepting this run's own delivery record under `docs/features/factory-fetch-each-pass/`.
scenarios.name: The delivered change meets the project's quality bar
when: the project's test suite and lint are run against the change
then: every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
every changed line is covered by a test that can fail
go test ./... passes and the lint step passes
no file outside scope.paths changes, except this run's own delivery record under docs/features/factory-fetch-each-pass/
